Description: Main user in the field. Performs inspections, executes repairs, consults technical documentation, and reports task status.
Leads the operational team, approves work requests, manages budgets, and ensures compliance with safety regulations.
High-level user who consumes information. Views dashboards with KPIs on asset health, costs, and downtime for strategic decision-making.
Defines the technical scope (HOW). Creates work plans, selects spare parts (BOM), and ensures resources are ready before scheduling.
Notes: Scheduling task was removed. Output is a WO in "Ready to Schedule" state.

Description: Specialist who uses the platform to perform inspections of Safety Critical Assets (SCA), report anomalies, and verify their correct resolution.
In charge of managing the inventory of spare parts and maintenance materials. Processes system requests, updates stock, and records material delivery.
User with limited access who receives specialized work orders, executes tasks, and uploads reports.
Notes: Two devices because they might upload field evidence accompanied by the Maintenance Technician (https://app.notion.com/p/Maintenance-Technician-2ce87c56a828804db57fd6c417865e7d?pvs=21) .

Description: Multifunctional role responsible for the Digital Twin. Creates and maintains the 3D model (CAD), manages software infrastructure (IT), and ensures integration with sensors and physical machinery (OT).
Uses historical and sensor data to develop predictive models, analyzes failure trends, calculates metrics like MTBF, and proposes improvements to the maintenance strategy.
Notes: In charge of the PMO discussed in the Draft.

Description: Technical role that manages users, permissions, integrations with other systems (e.g., ERP), and performs general platform maintenance.
The software agent that executes automatic tasks, monitors sensors, and generates alerts without human intervention.
Detects anomalies in machinery during production and generates Work Requests (SR). It is the first link in failure detection.
Notes: New actor to enable reporting from source (Trigger).

Description: Owner of the calendar (WHEN). Aligns planned orders with plant availability (production) and available technicians.
Notes: Key new role to separate "Planning" (What) from "Scheduling" (When).
